completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-188-O1-2021-ED-AIRPORT-PASSENGER-SERVICE-CHARGE-EXEMPTION-ORDER.pdf》（8 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: Citation 2 . Exemption from passenger service charge • • B.L.R. 0. 6/2021 • • • • [Subsidiary[ Order made under section 3(e) AIRPORT PASSENGER SERVICE CHARGE (EXEMPTION) ORDER • Citation

The following class of passengers are hereby exempted from payment of the passenger service charge referred to in section 2- Any passenger who, as evidenced by his passenger ticket, is scheduled to depart from Brunei Darussalam by an aircraft, within 24 hours of his time of arrival, for a destination in any country or territory other than the country or territory from which he embarked on the aircraft by which he arrived in Brunei Darussalam . • • • • • •
